door: A heavy ancient oak door creaking open slowly in a stone castle, iron hinges groaning, echo
magic: A shimmering magical chime swell, glittering crystal bells and a soft whoosh of light
geas: A powerful arcane binding spell: a deep resonant hum rising into a searing golden flare, a heartbeat thud and ringing crystal
bells: Distant cathedral bells tolling slowly through fog, deep and ominous
ward: An enormous ancient stone seal unlocking: deep grinding stone, then a single vast resonant bell-like note blooming with shimmering choir and chimes
anvil: A blacksmith hammer striking an anvil twice, ringing metal in a forge
clash: Swords clashing in a fight, steel on steel, two quick ringing strikes
storm: A violent storm at sea, crashing waves, howling wind and rain on a wooden ship
axe: Iron axes chopping into stone in a quiet forest, echoing, several strikes
fire: A sudden burst of fire whooshing up and roaring, crackling flames
thunder: A deep rolling thunder crack overhead, rumbling away
turn: A heavy stone ring rotating one notch, short grinding stone and a soft click
lock: A carved stone ring clicking firmly into place with a bright chime
